d: A controversial US Embassy post in Australia featuring a global freedom map has sparked debate over Washington’s credibility in judging other nations, after classifying the US and Australia as ‘Free’, India and Pakistan as ‘Partly Free’, and China and Russia as ‘Not Free’. Meanwhile, Singapore is challenging London and New York’s dominance of the global gold trade with a new bullion storage facility capable of holding 500 tonnes. As geopolitical rivalries reshape global influence and central banks expand their gold reserves, questions arise over America’s selective approach to freedom and…
